payload.reason: The evidence indicates that grammatical roles, particularly subject position, are associated with more frequent pronoun use compared to proper noun use.

claims.text: Pronouns are more frequently used for referents in subject position compared to proper nouns.
Prominence of a referent influences the choice of referring expressions, with pronouns being used for more prominent referents.
The grammatical role of the current mention is more important than that of the antecedent in predicting the choice of referential form.
